en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a formal military parade on a broad open square. A long line of uniformed soldiers stands at attention, each wearing a peaked cap, tunic with epaulettes, and carrying sidearms. At both ends of the line mounted officers on horses oversee the formation. Behind them are leafless or early‑spring trees, and in the distance several multi‑story historic buildings with steep roofs and towers, including what appears to be a church or town-hall tower. The image has irregular black borders typical of an old negative or contact print. No visible printed captions or handwriting appear on the front.
